note: Policies drafted from published coverage documents: Medicare LCDs and NCDs and public state Medicaid criteria. Each passes the drafting gates against its source (internal/draft/library_test.go). They are built into the program and decide as published (serve -library, on by default). A plan that reads a rule differently overrides the policy in the console (Override, with -edit-policies): its clinician-signed version of the same id decides instead. The AHIP/BCBSA standard documentation set for 66 services is not public (only its categories are), so the library is built from public documents; categories are named after AHIP's where they match.
